headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Atomberg Smart Fans. Enable **Developer Options** in the Atomberg Home app to obtain your **API Key** and **Refresh Token** (see the [developer portal](https://developer.atomberg-iot.com/#overview)).
footerDisplay: For help, open an issue on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dhananjaysathe/homebridge-atomberg-fan-v2/issues).

legacy5Speed.title: Legacy 5-speed mode
legacy5Speed.description: Enable only if your fan does not support the 6th Boost speed. When enabled, HomeKit's 0-100% maps to speeds 0-5 (in 20% steps) instead of 0-6 (continuous).
